name: Bulk Delete Comments
author: Shah Alom

sections.description: Allows you to delete all comments with a single click. You can select all unapproved and pending comments or comments based on category/post.
sections.installation:
Just a standard installation required.

  1. Plugins > Add New > Upload > ‘bulk-delete-comments.zip’ – Install Now
  2. Unzip & Upload ‘bulk-delete-comments.zip’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin back up comments in any other table?

No, it does not.
